from pathlib import Path
programs=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-prime-agent-luna6-high-fresh0/frozen/seen-reference-3/play/users/u073/system/state/workspace/programs')
programs.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
source='''from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    bg = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    candidates = []
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w - 2):
            vals = tuple(grid[r][c+i] for i in range(3))
            if all(v != bg for v in vals) and len(set(vals)) > 1:
                candidates.append(([(r, c+i) for i in range(3)], vals, (0, 1)))
    for r in range(h - 2):
        for c in range(w):
            vals = tuple(grid[r+i][c] for i in range(3))
            if all(v != bg for v in vals) and len(set(vals)) > 1:
                candidates.append(([(r+i, c) for i in range(3)], vals, (1, 0)))
    # The three-cell stamp is the unique contiguous non-background run.
    coords, stamp, axis = candidates[0]
    stamp_cells = set(coords)
    counts = Counter(v for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, v in enumerate(row)
                      if v != bg and (r, c) not in stamp_cells)
    marker = counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
    anchors = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w)
               if grid[r][c] == marker and (r, c) not in stamp_cells]
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    dr, dc = axis
    for r, c in anchors:
        for i, value in enumerate(stamp):
            rr, cc = r + (i - 1) * dr, c + (i - 1) * dc
            if 0 <= rr < h and 0 <= cc < w:
                out[rr][cc] = value
    return out
'''
